_comment: Bedrock on-demand token rates for the model in BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. These are NOT filled in: fill them from the AWS Bedrock pricing page for your region (https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/) and record where you read them and when. The harness refuses to run with nulls rather than substituting a guessed rate, because a cost number that nobody can trace is worse than no cost number.
